items.title: Abbie Williams Interview, 1966-06-02
items.q: The interviewee does not mention Brown directly; the interviewer identifies 'Grant Brown' and 'Henry Allen's band with Brown and Nelson' in the context of a photo/memory, but the interviewee's response focuses on transportation and food issues, not on a personal relationship with Brown.

ctx.x: Yeah, Soulard House that night. Hickle Bottom was down there full of wine. Hickle Bottom played that night.
You can see Brown and Nelson playing. Brown is playing too, Grant Brown.
Yeah, happy Goldstein. Yeah, he's the grand marshal that night.
